Does your calendar look like a solid wall of back-to-back meetings? It’s easy to feel burnt out when there’s zero gap between tasks. A simple beginner habit to fix this is scheduling "buffer zones." It transforms your schedule from a stressful list of demands into a manageable flow. Start small today and reclaim your focus.
